home.heroBody: Cut to order and weighed after cutting. You pay the exact weight, never a rounded guess.
home.categoriesBody: Eight counters, restocked each trading morning.
home.weighingHeading: You pay for what you get
home.weighingBody: Fish is cut to order, so the weight is never exact until it is on the scale. We show an estimate while you shop and charge the weight we actually cut.
home.deliveryBody: Home delivery only, within our local radius. Choose the window that suits you at checkout.

shop.title: The counter
shop.emptyBody: Stock is declared fresh each trading morning. Try another counter, or check back tomorrow.
shop.shopClosed: The shop has not opened today yet
shop.shopClosedBody: Stock is declared each trading morning. You can browse, but ordering opens when the counter does.

handling.hotExplainer: Cooked to order and delivered hot. Orders containing hot food can only use a delivery window that carries it.

product.estimatedNote: Estimated. You are charged the weight we actually cut.
product.fixedWeightNote: Sold as a pack. The price is fixed and the weight is as marked.
product.prepHeading: How would you like it prepared?
product.prepNote: Preparation is free and does not change the price.

basket.title: Your basket
basket.emptyBody: Everything on the counter is cut the day it goes out.
basket.estimateNote: Per-kilogram items stay estimated until your order is cut and weighed.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.phoneHelp: So the shop can reach you about your order.
checkout.phoneInvalid: Enter a 10 digit Canadian mobile number.
checkout.postalHelp: We deliver within a local radius.
checkout.notesHelp: Buzzer code, side door, anything the driver should know.
checkout.hotWarning: Your basket has hot kitchen food, so only windows that carry it are shown.

payment.testBannerTitle: Test order. No payment has been taken.
payment.testBannerBody: This is a working prototype. Card payment is not connected, so no money moves and nothing is charged.
payment.moneySentenceRest: We hold that as a maximum, then charge the exact amount once your fish is cut and weighed.

order.confirmedBody: We have your order. Keep this link to follow it.
order.notFound: We could not find that order
order.notFoundBody: The link may be incomplete. Check the address, or contact the shop.
order.historyEmptyBody: Once you place an order it will appear here.
order.reorderPartial: Some items are not on the counter today and were left out.

status.PREPARINGBody: Your fish is being cut and prepared.
status.WEIGHEDBody: Everything is weighed and your exact total is set.
status.READYBody: Packed and waiting for the driver.

verify.title: See your orders
verify.body: Enter your mobile number and we will show your recent orders.
verify.devNotice: Development mode. Phone numbers are not verified and the code is not sent by text.

errors.outsideDeliveryArea: We do not deliver to that postal code yet.
errors.insufficientStock: There is not enough of {name} left today.
errors.insufficientStockGeneric: There is not enough of one of these left today.
errors.slotFull: That delivery window just filled up. Choose another.
errors.slotClosed: That delivery window has closed for today.
errors.hotFoodNotAllowedInSlot: That window cannot carry hot kitchen food. Choose one that can.
errors.priceChanged: A price changed while you were shopping. Check the new total before continuing.
errors.shopClosed: The shop is not open for orders right now.
errors.illegalQuantity: That quantity is not available for this item.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.served: Yes, we deliver there. Delivery is {fee}.
delivery.servedFree: Yes, we deliver there, and delivery is free.
delivery.notServed: Not yet. We deliver within a local radius.

weighing.title: How weighing and payment work
weighing.intro: Fish is cut to order, so the exact weight is only known once it is on the scale.
weighing.step1Body: While you shop, per-kilogram items show an estimated price for the weight you asked for.
weighing.step2Body: At checkout we hold slightly more than the estimate, so a heavier cut does not fail.
weighing.step3Body: Once your order is cut and weighed we charge the exact amount, and never more than the maximum we held.

footer.heading: Cut here. Delivered nearby.
footer.body: Home delivery only, within our local radius. Everything is cut the day it goes out.
footer.priceNote: Prices in Canadian dollars. Per-kilogram prices stay estimated until your order is cut and weighed.
